abilities.name: GokuEquipmentAbility1
abilities.description:
Select a unit on the map or a position within this unit's range to $Relocate to for {1} seconds.
On $Relocate to a unit:
- Immediately perform a $FollowUpAttack dealing {2}% of this unit's current damage
- Trigger the selected unit to perform the same $FollowUpAttack dealing {3}% of the selected unit's current damage
On $Relocate to a position:
- Immediately perform a $FollowUpAttack dealing {4}% of this unit's current damage
- Increase this unit's Damage by {5}% for {1} seconds
